description: List all overall diameter values (inches) for high-flotation (HF) tyres, optionally filtered by region. HF tyres use the imperial size format: OD x SW R RD (e.g. 33x12.5R15). Common on pickup trucks and off-road vehicles. Use this to discover valid overall_diameter values for search-by-hf-tire.

region.description: Market region code (e.g. "usdm", "eudm"). Get codes from list-regions.

name: list-hf-tire-overall-diameters
